SELECT g.title AS value, g.id AS goods_id, g.category_id AS category_id, g.unit AS unit, g.pur_prc AS purPrc, g.sale_prc as salePrc, g.trade_prc as tradePrc, c.title AS categoryName, g.stock AS stock, (CASE WHEN c.title IS NOT NULL THEN '（' || c.title || '）' ELSE '' END) || ' ' || g.title AS label FROM app_goods g LEFT JOIN app_goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN app_supplier s ON g.supplier_id = s.id WHERE g.status = 1 and g.is_del = 0
AND ( g.title LIKE '%' || #{key} || '%'
OR g.py_code LIKE '%' || #{pyCode} || '%'
OR g.goods_code LIKE '%' || #{key} || '%' OR s.name LIKE '%' || #{key} || '%' )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.py_code LIKE '%' || #{pyCode} || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.title
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT g.* FROM app_goods g LEFT JOIN app_goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN app_supplier s ON g.supplier_id = s.id WHERE g.status = 1 and g.is_del = 0 AND ( g.title LIKE '%' || #{query.key} || '%'
OR g.py_code LIKE '%' || #{query.pyCode} || '%'
OR g.goods_code LIKE '%' || #{query.key} || '%' OR s.name LIKE '%' || #{query.key} || '%' )
order by g.${query.column} ${query.order}
